timing_search.transition_rule: recenter by 0.20 s at unchanged spacing while the winner is on an edge
timing_search.acceptance_rule: each group must select an interior converged timing node before geographic search

model: exact causal per-NORAD rate with profiled per-track CFO
geographic_objective: information-weighted regularized exact rate selection objective
geographic_transition_rule: translate at unchanged spacing while the winner is on the edge; halve only after an interior winner
checkpoint_policy: validate plan, parent, and identity-source digests before reusing complete timing or geographic steps
postseal_policy: the geographic reference may be read only after inference.json is sealed
